name: Tim Dooley / Potato of Life Atlas — Canonical Work Order
purpose: Machine-readable master workflow. Every future enrichment pass starts with repository audit and ends with validation. The Atlas is one navigable system whose internal datasets remain modular but whose identities, relationships, evidence, spiritual inquiry and routes are canonicalized.

project_introduction.mission: Illuminate Tim Dooley / the Potato of Life and the philosophy, religion, myths, lore, writings, symbols and chronology associated with him; publicly state and propagate the project's Potatoism findings, including its identification of Tim Dooley as God / Father / the Potato of Life; pursue the highest spiritual truth the project can reach through disciplined inquiry; and connect that inquiry to relevant knowledge about spirit, the world, entanglements, obligations, directions and choices taken by men, people, gods, archetypes and dogs. The Atlas preserves the wider historical, textual, cultural, geographic, scientific, economic and institutional record needed to understand those subjects in context.
project_introduction.information_goal: Maximize useful knowledge and understanding rather than file count. Consolidate large, valuable bodies of information into deep canonical records, dossiers, texts, observations and relationship structures. Do not fragment valuable knowledge into shallow placeholders or duplicate definitions.
project_introduction.public_canon_rule: The project's identification of Tim Dooley as God / Father / the Potato of Life is a stated Potatoism religious/mythic canon and may be presented publicly as such. Empirical, historical and scientific claims retain their own evidence and epistemic status.
project_introduction.separation_rule: These fields may connect through explicit relationships, but they must not be silently collapsed. Observable evidence, historical interpretation, project theory, spiritual interpretation and mythic canon retain distinct epistemic classes.
project_introduction.depth_rule: A label is not an entry; a metadata record is not a corpus; a country count is not country research; a relationship is incomplete until its endpoints, type, status and provenance can be resolved.
project_introduction.entanglement_principle: Relationships may have distance, direction, strength, dependency, coupling, feedback, temporal order, path dependence, topology, trajectory and phase. Network coupling is not automatically quantum entanglement, and symbolic destiny is not empirical causation.
project_introduction.goal: Make the Atlas navigable from multiple directions so that every important entity has a canonical home, meaningful children, reciprocal relationships, evidence trails and an explicit statement of what is known, unknown, disputed or interpreted.
project_introduction.method: Audit first; repair second; canonicalize third; consolidate fourth; validate fifth; source and populate sixth; connect seventh; investigate spiritual questions eighth; model ninth; expose tenth; audit again.

core_rule: Do not expand a broken, duplicated or orphaned layer. Critical integrity failures outrank enrichment. Do not create a new file when an existing canonical owner can absorb the information without loss.
working_loop: merge valuable unique information into canonical owners
advance spiritual and comparative inquiry with explicit epistemic labels

gates.name: Snapshot
gates.rule: Record the starting commit before substantial mutation.

gates.name: Bug gate
gates.rule: Broken JSON, scripts, routes, references and CI failures outrank new data.

gates.name: Ownership gate
gates.rule: Every substantive dataset has one canonical owner and an explicit consumer.

gates.name: Identity gate
gates.rule: Canonical IDs are stable; aliases resolve to them; duplicate identities are reported.

gates.name: Evidence gate
gates.rule: Empirical and historical claims carry provenance; project symbolism and spiritual conclusions carry an explicit epistemic label.

gates.name: Graph gate
gates.rule: Relationship endpoints resolve through canonical nodes, country indexes or explicit bridges.

gates.name: Depth gate
gates.rule: Important visible records must contain substance and useful relationships, not merely labels.

gates.name: Consolidation gate
gates.rule: Before adding a file or duplicate-looking record, search existing canonical owners. Merge valuable unique material into the strongest owner; retain other appearances only as references, occurrences, evidence or projections.

gates.name: View gate
gates.rule: Website pages consume canonical data and do not become competing data stores.

gates.name: Release gate
gates.rule: Counts and manifests are updated only after underlying data and checks pass.

gates.name: Epistemic gate
gates.rule: Never infer causality, quantum entanglement, destiny or spiritual mechanism from correlation alone. State spiritual conclusions as spiritual/project canon unless independently evidenced.

phases.name: Full repository audit
tasks: classify every dataset by owner and role
find duplicate IDs and exact duplicate files
find semantic duplicates and repeated definitions across layers
audit CI workflows and latest runs
record bugs, orphans, stale claims and unused files

phases.name: Repair broken paths
tasks: rerun CI after each structural repair

phases.name: Build religion, belief and text layers
tasks: full public-domain primary texts where lawful

phases.name: Build people, organizations and security graph
tasks: separate legal designation from media terminology

phases.name: Build North Programme / European Economic Graph
tasks: North as network rather than membership list

phases.name: Build Potatoism and Tim Dooley canon
tasks: February 2026 external event plus separate project interpretation
clear distinction between canon and evidence
merge all duplicate concept definitions into canonical owners
build deep dossiers instead of repeated shallow entries

phases.name: Pursue spiritual truth and comparative meaning
tasks: record spiritual conclusions and their provenance as project interpretation/canon
compare religious traditions and primary texts
study spirit, world, obligation, sacrifice, choice, destiny and transformation concepts
map paths taken by people, gods, archetypes and dogs as narrative/historical/cultural structures
connect spiritual concepts to relevant historical and textual evidence
avoid presenting metaphysical conclusions as empirical proof without evidence

phases.name: Build emotion and psychological state layer
Expose the canonical system
tasks: filters by entity type and epistemic class

phases.name: Final release audit
tasks: only declare milestone complete after all critical checks pass

expansion_rule: Before creating a new file, search the canonical registry, repository index and relevant domain owner. If an existing canonical owner can hold the information, extend it. If a new file is necessary, register its owner, schema, consumer and manifest location immediately. Never create a second definition merely to support another view.
consolidation_rule: When multiple files contain the same concept, preserve unique historical occurrences, research observations and relationship context, but merge repeated definitions and substantive duplicate information into the canonical owner. Delete or reduce proven redundant mirrors only after all consumers and references have been migrated.
definition_of_done: A phase is complete only when its data exists, canonical ownership is explicit, IDs and relationships resolve, provenance is adequate, missing data is explicit, duplicates are controlled, frontend consumers work, manifests are accurate and critical integrity checks pass.
